name: meta-tagging platform - concept definition component
note: The second concept, and the reason the first one is not just a study of art. Same files, same field names, same arithmetic in the browser as data/ (art) - only the corpus differs. Chosen because it is the concept Wittgenstein used to argue that some concepts have no definition, so the method is being tested on the hardest available example.
license: CC BY 4.0 for the tag layer. Paper text is (c) its authors and is linked, never redistributed here; quotes are short and for identification.

papers.json.what: one record per paper a visitor can put in a corpus

cases.json.what: one record per case; `quote` is an exact substring of the paper

definitions.json.what: the rival definitions, their gate verdict and their published score

verdicts.json.what: definition id -> one character per case, in case index order

how_to_score: Identical to the art concept. Take every case whose paper is in your set and whose status is P or N; SKIP any case whose verdict character is '-'; compare the character to the status; MCC = (TP*TN - FP*FN) / sqrt((TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)). The 'label-copy' control must score +1.000 on any corpus.

abstention.what: Only a definition with may_abstain=true may carry '-' verdicts. One does: Wittgenstein's family-resemblance account, whose content IS that the concept has no boundary, so forcing a yes or no on a borderline case would score a position nobody holds.
abstention.the_catch: An abstainer is graded only on what it answered, so its score and the others' are not the same test. definitions.published.answered is the coverage, and GAME_CASE/scores_game_v1.json carries an `equal_footing` table that re-scores everyone on exactly the cases the abstainer answered. On that table it stops leading.

calibration_rule.why_not_circular: The art concept calibrates on 'whatever people call art', which is a tautology there. For GAME the same sentence is a substantive and contested position - this literature is expressly in the business of overruling ordinary usage - so it scores +0.640 and loses to five published definitions. It is therefore a CONTENDER here, not a control, and the control that calibrates the table copies the corpus label instead.

definition_wording: Every definition's `wording` field says whether the sentence on screen is a quotation or ours. Eight are verbatim from the table in Juul (2003), which is in this corpus and is checked at build time. Three are ours, each with a citation: Wittgenstein (we do not hold the Investigations) and Shir Sivroni's two readings of her own phrase.
limitations: Four papers. Every number here is over a corpus that small, and no confidence interval is reported because a four-cluster bootstrap would be meaningless.
Comparable only WITHIN this run. The game numbers and the art numbers are NOT comparable with each other - only the method is.
Two of the four papers are by the same journal's contributors arguing with each other, which is what makes the negative cases good and the sample narrow.
